reuse.why: One new guard is called from every existing provider link function, using the tree's db.first helper.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link query and error exist once; each provider only passes its sync source, account id and upgradingId.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers, though accounts/link.ts already gathers shared link helpers; in linkEnableBankingAccount the call is wedged between the bank-id comment and the code it describes.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: A single clearly named guard is easy to own; new providers must still remember to call it because the link functions remain per-provider copies.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts assertNotLinkedElsewhere, called by all five provider link functions
